title: Merge upstream godotengine/master into fork
body:
# Major Changes Summary

This is a large merge from the upstream Godot Engine repository containing numerous improvements across the engine. Key highlights include:

## Core & Infrastructure
- **Decouple and refactor**: Extensive decoupling of core systems (RenderingServer, DisplayServer, etc.) to reduce interdependencies
- **Include optimization**: Systematic removal of unused includes via clang-tidy integration in CI
- **Test improvements**: Convert test headers to compilation files for better compile-time organization
- **Signal ownership**: Move signal ownership from `ClassDB` to `GDType` for better organization

## Rendering & Graphics
- **HDR output**: Support for HDR output on all platforms including Apple and Linux/Wayland
- **HarfBuzz update**: Upgrade to 13.1.1 with new raster and vector SVG rendering capabilities
- **D3D12MA upgrade**: Update to latest D3D12 Memory Allocator
- **Metal improvements**: Various Metal rendering fixes and optimizations
- **GLES3 optimizations**: Shader utilities refactoring and include cleanup

## Editor Features
- **3D editor enhancements**: Vertex snapping, freelook improvements, better orbit controls
- **Animation editor**: Improvements to BlendSpace editors, animation tree optimization, key visualization
- **UI/UX improvements**: Better docking system, accessibility enhancements, improved search/filter
- **Scene painter**: New 2D painting tool for scene editing
- **GridMap improvements**: Better selection, rotation, collision visualization

## Platform Support
- **Android**: Haptic feedback, Picture-in-Picture support, improved JNI handling
- **iOS/visionOS**: UI preference propagation, static library loading fixes
- **macOS**: ANGLE support in VMs, improved window handling
- **Linux/Wayland**: HDR support, key mapping improvements, wayland-protocols updates
- **Web**: Improved SDL joypad support

## Input & Accessibility
- **Input improvements**: Device IDs for keyboard/mouse events, joypad motion sensors
- **Accessibility server**: Dedicated accessibility singleton with improved CodeEdit support
- **Virtual Joystick**: Better styling and configuration options

## Physics & Animation
- **Jolt Physics**: Update to 5.5.0 with various improvements and fixes
- **Animation optimization**: Better animation resource/library/mixer/player performance
- **Tween improvements**: Add `has_tweeners()` method, AwaitTweener support

## GDScript & Scripting
- **Coroutine fixes**: Proper stack clearing for interrupted coroutines
- **Performance**: Improved signal emission, better completion for setters/getters
- **Documentation**: LSP improvements, better error handling

## Build & CI
- **Python requirement**: Bump to 3.9 minimum
- **Clang-tidy integration**: Systematic code quality improvements
- **GitHub Actions**: Enhanced CI with changed-files detection and validation hooks

## Documentation
- Improved class documentation across audio, physics, rendering, and UI systems
- Better clarification of feature limitations and platform-specific behaviors

The merge maintains compatibility while significantly improving code organization, build system, and feature set.
